title: Mindin-mediated alphaM-integrin endocytosis activates STAT3 to maintain keratinocyte stemness.
authors: Dam, Binita; Ajnabi, Johan; Saha, Tirthankar; Shrivastava, Ashish; Badarinath, Krithika; Hegde, Akshay; Dutta, Abhik; Jasoria, Siddham; Kataria, Sunny; Singh, Ashutosh; Jamora, Colin
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Mindin通过整合素内吞激活STAT3维持角质细胞干性，虽涉及分子动力学模拟和转录因子STAT3，但核心是整合素信号转导而非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Keratinocyte stem cells are essential for maintaining epidermal homeostasis and enabling efficient tissue repair. Regulation of their self-renewal and differentiation is critical, as its disruption can impair regeneration and drive pathological conditions such as chronic wounds and cancer. We previously identified the matricellular protein Mindin as a key regulator of keratinocyte stemness through its interaction with the alphaMbeta2 (CD11b/CD18) integrin and subsequent activation of the transcription factor STAT3. However, the mechanism connecting Mindin and integrin at the cell surface to the intracellular activation of STAT3 remained undefined. METHODS: We employ biochemical and imaging analysis along with molecular dynamics simulations to dissect Mindin-integrin-STAT3 signalling in primary mouse keratinocytes. Stemness of epidermal keratinocytes are assessed using bulk RNA sequencing, quantitative PCR, and cell-based assays. RESULTS: Our work demonstrates that the F-Spondin domain of Mindin constitutes the minimal integrin-binding module required to initiate downstream signalling. F-Spondin binding to the integrin at the plasma membrane does not elicit the full activation state of the integrin. Instead, it promotes Src-kinase dependent endocytosis of the integrin receptor to the early endosomes. Analysis of integrin conformational dynamics reveals that the acidic environment of early endosomes is essential to achieve a signalling-competent state. This mechanism extends to pathological contexts, as we demonstrate a requirement for endocytosis in activating STAT3 signalling and preserving stem-like properties in a cancer stem cell model. CONCLUSIONS: These findings highlight a previously unrecognized layer of spatial control in integrin signalling, confirming endosomal trafficking as a critical determinant of stem cell behaviour and offering new conceptual and therapeutic opportunities across regenerative biology and cancer.
abstract_zh: 背景：角质形成细胞干细胞对于维持表皮稳态和实现高效组织修复至关重要。其自我更新和分化的调控至关重要，因为该过程的紊乱可损害再生并驱动慢性伤口和癌症等病理状态。我们此前鉴定出基质细胞蛋白Mindin通过其与alphaMbeta2（CD11b/CD18）整合素的相互作用及随后转录因子STAT3的激活，作为角质形成细胞干性的关键调控因子。然而，连接细胞表面Mindin与整合素至细胞内STAT3激活的机制仍不明确。方法：我们采用生化和成像分析以及分子动力学模拟，解析原代小鼠角质形成细胞中Mindin-整合素-STAT3信号通路。通过批量RNA测序、定量PCR和基于细胞的实验评估表皮角质形成细胞的干性。结果：我们的工作表明，Mindin的F-Spondin结构域构成启动下游信号传导所需的最小整合素结合模块。F-Spondin在质膜上与整合素结合并不引发整合素的完全激活状态。相反，它促进整合素受体的Src激酶依赖性内吞至早期内体。整合素构象动力学分析揭示，早期内体的酸性环境对于实现信号传导胜任状态至关重要。该机制延伸至病理情境，因为我们证明在癌症干细胞模型中，内吞对于激活STAT3信号传导和维持干样特性是必需的。结论：这些发现突显了整合素信号传导中一个此前未被认识的空间调控层面，确认内体运输作为干细胞行为的关键决定因素，并为再生生物学和癌症领域提供新的概念和治疗机会。
